title: 학력인정학교지정규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1

Article 4 (Revocation of Designation, etc.)
(1) Where a designated school ceases to meet the designation standards under Article 3, the Minister of Education or Superintendent of Education may revoke its designation. [Amended on January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; and March 23, 2013.]
(2) Where necessary to revoke a designation under paragraph (1), the Minister of Education or Superintendent of Education may order the relevant school to submit necessary materials or may inspect its books, documents, etc. [Amended on January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; and March 23, 2013.]
